verdict.rationale: The Editor API and MCP server let AI assistants or scripts programmatically manipulate scenes, assets, and project data (playcanvas-docs-9, playcanvas-docs-30, playcanvas-docs-6), and SplatTransform explicitly supports batch conversion/merging/filtering of splat data (playcanvas-docs-22) — both imply bulk automation is possible, but no documentation explicitly demonstrates bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch-editing hundreds of entities/assets) or provides a purpose-built bulk API. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit examples/documentation, dedicated batch endpoints in the Editor API, independent confirmation of large-scale automated edits.
